mod.help: Settings for the Spirit Multiplier mod.

count.title: Spirit Count
count.help: How many spirits each Spirit Ash summons.

multiplier.label: Multiplier
multiplier.help: Times an Ash's usual spirit count (decimals allowed, e.g. 1.5). Used when Fixed Count is 0. 1 = vanilla, 0 = off.

fixed_count.label: Fixed Count
fixed_count.help: Spirits every Ash summons, whatever its usual count. 0 = use the Multiplier instead.

max_spirits.label: Max Spirits
max_spirits.help: Most spirits one Ash can summon. Above 60 may lower FPS or crash. Applies after restarting the game.

summoning.title: Summoning
summoning.help: How and where spirits can be summoned.

multi_spirit.label: Multi Spirit
multi_spirit.help: Summon several different Spirit Ashes at the same time.

clone_spirit.label: Clone Spirit
clone_spirit.help: Needs Multi Spirit. Using an Ash again summons another copy instead of sending it back.

no_rest.label: Resummon Without Rest
no_rest.help: Summon your spirits again without resting at a Site of Grace.

anywhere.label: Summon Anywhere
anywhere.help: Summon spirits outside the usual summoning pool areas.

health.title: Health and Look
health.help: How spirits heal and how they look.

regen_mode.label: Regen Mode
regen_mode.help: What the healing amount means. Also heals Torrent.

regen_amount.label: Regen Amount
regen_amount.help: Healing per second: HP in Flat HP mode, a percent in the other modes (decimals allowed). 0 = no healing.

ghost.label: Ghostly Tint
ghost.help: On = spirits keep their ghostly blue look. Off = they look like normal characters.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.help: Make spirits smarter in a fight.

senses.label: Senses
senses.help: Spirits notice enemies from farther away and remember them longer.

aggression.label: Aggression
aggression.help: Spirits start fighting sooner, attack together and call for help.

follow.label: Follow
follow.help: Spirits stay closer to you and cross ledges, ladders and holes to keep up.

teleport.title: Teleport
teleport.help: Experimental: spirits teleport to you sooner. 0 = game default.

warp_far.label: Warp When Far
warp_far.help: Also teleport spirits that are far away even if they can see you.

warp_distance.label: Distance (m)
warp_distance.help: Teleport when a spirit is farther than this many metres. 0 = game default.

warp_blocked.label: Blocked Time (s)
warp_blocked.help: Teleport after this many seconds without line of sight. 0 = game default.

warp_stuck_time.label: Stuck Time (s)
warp_stuck_time.help: Teleport after being stuck this many seconds. 0 = game default.

warp_stuck_range.label: Stuck Range (m)
warp_stuck_range.help: Moving less than this many metres counts as stuck. 0 = game default.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
